title: Routing simulator: tune the LFG routing design
scenario: LFG's Monday routing design was a one-to-one copy of Avaya skills, and nobody could say what happens to VIP and SAP calls when the apps team also takes overflow. Build a deterministic model of Connect routing (profile priority and delay, contact priority, proficiency steps, abandons) and use it to tune the design.
task: Implement the routing semantics: event order, eligibility, best-contact ordering
Routing criteria steps with expiry and any-agent fallback
Metrics: SL with abandons, ASA, abandon rate, occupancy
Tune routing profiles to hit 80% everywhere and 90% VIP with the same agents
Explain causes, changes and robustness in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Hand-built scenarios pass for every routing rule
Baseline figures match the reference semantics exactly
Deterministic, no input mutation, 20,000 contacts in under 5 s
Tuned design meets the targets with the same agents and proficiencies
